This barely needs a plot; the characters and setting that it provides are entertaining enough to carry this and probably a few more stories by themselves. I love the constant juxtaposition of perfectly normal and believable artist/craftsperson interactions with the enormous weirdness of the arts and crafts they're doing (and the relatively minor weirdness of the place they're interacting in).

I want more BackdoorSoho, and I want more of the unnamed artist's unnamed project. Therefore, you have succeeded. Take my upvote.
